queries:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') AS rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')
),
base AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, b.baseline
  FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b
  WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_mod AS avg_modindex,
       avg_mod - baseline AS above_baseline,
       avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS baseline
  FROM g
),
k AS (
  SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex, g.avg_modindex - b.baseline AS above_baseline
  FROM g, b
  WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.baseline
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  above_baseline,
  avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM k;
